summary:
I checked SL-110 (82e6692 against f764c34; only src/FsAnalyser.App changed, not Core) by running it. Two of those runs touched something real: the published exe stopping a scan of C:\ProgramData, and real Explorer in R-004.

**Suite, rules and mutants**
- Full suite: 1023/1023 pass.
- Fitness: 99 rules hold.
- Rules harness, under the engine's own venv: 167/167 AS-RECORDED.
- RuleCases C-001 and C-003 pass.
- WindowMutants -Mutant All catches 12 of 12 in 391 s (required by Q-114).
- In-process Facts: SL-063 10/10 and SL-100 29/29.

**New window cases (all pass)**
- **T-010 (13 s).** The store marks 200 entries not listed, and the walk read 200 rows, all drawn 'not read yet' with blank figures and no expander. p00-p04 sit at depth 1 and 195 of m-mid's subfolders at depth 2. a-empty and b-listed\empty read '0 bytes'. b-listed\denied reads 'could not be opened' and is the only row in the panel. The nine list titles are byte-identical after tree → Folders. Run 2 (completed scan) offers no tree choice, and no row says 'not read yet'. Run 3 releases the stopped store twice and resets the choice.
- **T-011 (59 s).** Pressed at j-before. m-big is cut in its listing: NotListed, 'not read yet', no figure or expander, and the panel is empty.
- **T-012 (60 s).** Stopped m-big has 9,994 unlisted rows and opens in 73.7, 2.4, 1.8, 1.9 and 2.3 ms. The completed m-big opens in 67.3 ms, with 0 not listed.
- **R-004 (10 s, unattended per Q-275).** Status line '', LastRevealOutcome Exact, Explorer selection z-unread. No windows were left open.

**Existing window cases**
- Pass unchanged: T-006, L-001, L-002, T-001, K-001, K-002, K-003, T-002, T-004, T-007, T-009 and L-003.
- T-003 fails only on its 'taller window' VOID check (241.9 against 241.9 px). This display's default window already fills the 816 px work area. All its opens pass (101.6 and 104.4 ms cold). The slice does not touch T-003's code, and the builder measured the same failure at HEAD.

**Real data: published exe stopped inside C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Windows**
- The walk read 574 rows. All 60 not-listed rows reached (of 66 the store marks) drew 'not read yet' with no figures, bar or expander.
- No listed row said 'not read yet'.
- None of the 12 unreadable-panel rows is an unread folder.
- 32 listed empty folders drew '0 bytes'.
- The list and the tree agree on all 59 top rows (29 NotRead).
- Open in Explorer is enabled on the unread NVIDIA row, and its path equals the store's.

**Not reached:** the network pass (Q-274), Q-270's 5M-entry memory, R-001 to R-003 after the hook's FindInTreeItem change, a hardware click, and Windows 10.

checks.evidence: Passed! Failed: 0, Passed: 1023, Skipped: 0 (FsAnalyser.Core.Tests, 32 s). EXIT=0. This includes StoppedTreeOfferTests and StopTargetTests.

checks.evidence: T-006 PASSED in 31 s ('FolderTree is not shown after a stop', list in view). L-001 PASSED in 29 s (notRead+stoppedPartway=16). L-002 PASSED in 54 s (17 ok). T-001 PASSED in 3 s (82 ok).

checks.evidence: All exit 0, with no FAIL line in any log. K-001 6 s, K-002 29 s, K-003 32 s, T-002 3 s, T-004 33 s, T-007 6 s, T-009 3 s, L-003 4 s.

checks.what: T-003 (required at validate by Q-128 for slices touching FolderTreeNode)
checks.evidence:
FAILED (exit 1, 52 s) on one check only: 'VOID unless the taller window gave the tree more room than the default (241.9 px against 241.9 px)'. All 10 opens pass (cold 101.6 and 104.4 ms; warm 1.4-2.6 ms).

- 574 rows walked, 0 unrendered; 60 not-listed rows reached, all drawn 'not read yet' with onDisk, size and share blank, no expander, no bar.
- 0 listed rows say 'not read yet'.
- The panel's 12 unreadable paths include 0 not-listed rows; 9 listed rows read 'could not be opened' and 5 'link, not followed'.
- 32 listed empty folders draw '0 bytes' with no expander.

The drift is in test-hook navigation, not product code. The reviewer traced the current targets and found no name collision.

checks.what: Stopped 5M-entry store with the tree open on a 100k-child folder, under 1 GiB (Q-270)
checks.evidence: Q-270 is still open, and no case or tool in the tree measures it. A whole-drive or synthetic 5M stopped run is outside this validation's bounded scope.

criteria.criterion: 1. Show a folder the stopped scan never listed in the stopped tree: queued folders at depth 1 (p00-p04) and at depth 2 under a listed folder (m-mid's unlisted subfolders)
criteria.how: T-010 run 1: the walk read 200 not-listed rows (the store marks 200), all drawn 'not read yet' with no figures, bar or expander. That is p00-p04 at depth 1 and 195 of m-mid's subfolders at depth 2. Real C:\ProgramData run: 60 of 60 not-listed rows reached drew the same.

criteria.criterion: 2. Decide whether a stopped ending offers a tree at all (Stop in the root's listing: root NotListed, TopLevel null; or before the root is appended: empty store)
criteria.how: StoppedTreeOfferTests in the default suite (1023/1023) sweep the Stop over every guarded call. OffersStoppedTree is false for an empty store, for a root nobody listed and for a RootUnreadable file root, and true once the root is listed. In code it is `Cancelled && TopLevel is not null`, and ShowOutcome only shows ShowTreeButton when it holds.

criteria.criterion: 3. Show a folder that was listed and is empty in the stopped tree (a-empty at depth 1, b-listed\empty at depth 2)
criteria.how: T-010: a-empty and b-listed\empty read note '', '0 bytes', no expander. T-011: j-before reads '0 bytes'. Real ProgramData: 32 listed empty folders draw '0 bytes' with no note.

criteria.criterion: 4. Word an unread top-level folder the same in the stopped list and the tree
criteria.how: T-010: 'each top-level folder is not read in the list exactly when the store marks it, in the tree's own word', and after tree → Folders the titles are byte-identical. Real ProgramData: 59 top rows, 29 NotRead, 0 mismatches against the tree's store mark. SL-063 10/10. Both surfaces read TopLevelRowText.NotReadYet.

criteria.criterion: 5. Show a folder Stop cut inside its own listing (m-big, pressedAt == j-before)
criteria.how: T-011: pressedAt j-before. m-big draws 'not read yet' with no figure, bar or expander, and no word of a folder that could not be read. The panel is empty, the list title is 'm-big  (not read yet)', and the store marks m-big not listed.

criteria.criterion: 6. Keep failed folders and unread folders apart after a Stop (deny-ACE b-listed\denied beside unread folders)
criteria.how: T-010: denied reads 'could not be opened', the panel names it and no not-listed folder, and no not-listed row carries a failure word. Real ProgramData: none of the 12 panel paths is a not-listed row, and the 9 'could not be opened' rows are all storeNotListed false.

criteria.criterion: 7. Word a folder that is both not listed and in the unreadable record
criteria.how: StoppedTreeOfferTests asserts at every sweep stop that no unreadable entry is NotListed (passed in the suite), so a real Stop never produces this state. FolderTreeNode.Note places the NotReadYet arm before the FailedKind arm. I read that wording in the diff; no row in that combined state was drawn, because none can be produced.

criteria.criterion: 8. Open a 100k-child folder in a stopped tree (m-big listed, at least 5,000 of 10,000 subfolders unlisted, 5 opens)
criteria.how: T-012 stopped run: 9,994 unlisted. Opens took 73.7, 2.4, 1.8, 1.9 and 2.3 ms, each with 25 rows built; the limit is 500 ms.

criteria.criterion: 9. Open a 100k-child folder in a completed tree (every NotListed false)
criteria.how: T-012 completed run: 0 not-listed children; opens took 67.3, 1.9, 1.8, 1.5 and 1.6 ms. T-003's opens (101.6 and 104.4 ms cold) also pass; only its environmental VOID check fails.

criteria.criterion: 10. Offer Open in Explorer on a 'not read yet' row (p04 selected in the stopped tree)
criteria.how: T-010 can-reveal p04: selected, focused, canExecute true, pathOf equal to the store's GetPath. Real ProgramData: NVIDIA ('not read yet') canExecute true with path C:\ProgramData\NVIDIA, equal to the store's.

criteria.criterion: 11. Land in Explorer on a 'not read yet' folder (z-unread behind n-slow\)
criteria.how: R-004 run unattended per Q-275: status line '', LastRevealOutcome Exact. Real Explorer showed the root with z-unread as its only selection. No windows were left open.

criteria.criterion: 12. Finish a scan and switch views (File kinds and back to Folders, no stop)
criteria.how: T-010 run 2: no tree choice is offered, and kinds → Folders shows the finished tree again with the same header. K-001, K-002, K-003 and T-001 pass. The WindowMutants suite is green.

criteria.criterion: 13. End a scan with Stop and look at the default view (nobody picks the tree)
criteria.how: T-006, L-001 and L-002 pass unchanged, and the EndingObeysSkip mutant is caught. T-010, T-011 and T-012 each assert that the stopped ending opens on the list, with the tree hidden until chosen.

criteria.criterion: 14. Start a new scan after looking at a stopped tree
criteria.how: T-010 run 3: the stopped store was collectable once the second scan started and again after it ended. Folders is checked again and the tree choice is hidden. The second tree's store marks 0 not listed, and none of its 5 rows says 'not read yet'.

planned.evidence: T-010 compares every not-listed row it walks against the store's own count (200 = 200), and all of them draw 'not read yet' with no '0 bytes'. The rows are read through the hook's WALK lines instead of the schema-1 report, because the report carries no rows (Q-016); the design made that substitution. On real data (C:\ProgramData) 60 of 60 walked not-listed rows were drawn correctly and no listed row was drawn as unread.
T-010: a-empty and b-listed\empty, listed before the Stop, read '0 bytes' with no note or expander. Real ProgramData: 32 listed empty folders draw '0 bytes'.
T-010's list-against-tree check passes. Real ProgramData: 59 top rows, 29 NotRead, 0 mismatches against the tree's store mark. Both surfaces read the one constant TopLevelRowText.NotReadYet.

T-011 stops inside m-big's 100k listing (pressedAt j-before). Its row reads 'not read yet', not an unreadable or partly-read word, and the unreadable panel is empty. The stopped tree's header leads with 'Not read yet: folders the stop came before', which names the stop. The design settled using the shared word plus that header, not a distinct word (U-189).
T-012 stopped run: m-big has 9,994 unlisted subfolders and opened in 73.7 ms cold, then 2.4, 1.8, 1.9 and 2.3 ms, all under 500 ms.
R-004 was run unattended (Q-275) against real Explorer: z-unread is revealed from the stopped tree, the status line is empty, LastRevealOutcome is Exact, and Explorer's only selection is z-unread.

Completed scans show 'not read yet' nowhere: T-010 run 2 (268 rows, none marked), T-012's completed run (0 not listed) and T-010 run 3's second tree.
- Existing cases pass unchanged: T-006, L-001, L-002, T-001, K-001, K-002, K-003, T-002, T-004, T-007, T-009, L-003; mutants 12/12; SL-063 10/10; SL-100 29/29.
- T-003 fails only on its environmental 'taller window' VOID check (816 px window = 816 px work area), which fails identically at HEAD f764c34. Its code is untouched and its opens pass.
- I did not run -Case All (network, cloud and S-cases were not run).

obligations.evidence: T-010 run 2 ran again here: at a completed ending, File kinds then Folders shows the finished tree (one item, same header). The gate `if (ShowTreeButton.Visibility != Visible) return` is in OnResultsViewChanged.
Measured here: T-010 13 s, T-011 59 s, T-012 60 s, R-004 10 s, T-003 52 s, all under the 120 s case limit.
R-004 re-run passed: status line '', Exact, Explorer selection z-unread, no windows left.
T-006, L-001, L-002 and T-001 pass. WindowMutants -Mutant All 12/12 (EndingObeysSkip caught). SL-063 10/10 and SL-100 29/29.
T-010 run 3: the store is released twice, Folders is checked, the tree choice is hidden, and the second tree marks 0 not listed.
T-010 run 3 logs store-released true when the second scan started and again after it ended, so the hook's store reads do not keep the stopped store alive.
StoppedTreeOfferTests pass in the default suite (1023/1023).

not_reached: Stop on a stalled SMB share and the SMB-LOOPBACK / TEST-NET-1 network pass (Q-274). This slice touched MainWindow, the hook and WindowCases.ps1, and the pass is still owed by a person; no engine stage may change SMB mappings.
Q-270: a stopped 5M-entry store with the stopped tree open on a 100k-child folder, measured against 1 GiB. Nothing here measures it.
R-001 to R-003 were not re-run after the undeclared RevealMode.FindInTreeItem direct-child pass. They open real Explorer windows, and Q-275's unattended allowance covers R-004 only.
No hardware click: the hook chooses 'Folder tree' and Folders in-process, and no SendInput mouse click on the radio button was made.
T-003's taller-window comparison cannot run on this display (default window 816 px = work area 816 px), so the reopen condition's taller-viewport half is unmeasured here.
A whole-drive (C:\) stopped tree. The real-data run covered C:\ProgramData only (6,743 entries at the Stop).
Windows 10, and displays or DPI other than this one. No such machine exists here.
